description: Kysthjelperne 2025: survey export (sampling log) + eDNA sequence data (LCA table).

edna._comment: The LCA table is matched to the Prove ID in raw_data.csv. Row names H-2013 / R-2013 are two sequencing runs of sample 2013 (kept apart, never added up); H-N2660 = field blank; H-MOCK / H-PCR-neg = lab controls.
edna.title: eDNA metabarcoding - Kysthjelperne 2025
edna.description: Citizen-science eDNA sampling along the Oslofjord. The species list comes from an LCA classification of metabarcoding reads and covers all organism groups, not only fish. A name with 'or N other species' means the sequence could not separate those species.
